name: Incident Command and Postmortem
description: Correlate a local alert stream into incidents, open a bridge for severity 1, draft a status note for customer-facing issues, and file internal noise.

parameters.content:
## Alerts
Twenty-five sample alerts. Correlation collapses repeats of the same service and symptom into one incident.

## Command
Severity 1 opens a bridge and a rollback note. Other customer-facing incidents get a status draft. Internal noise is filed, not paged.
